solver_timeout_status: Provisional; separately revisitable before solver execution
software_choice: Open: alternative tools are allowed if outputs meet the validated public contract; broad implementation independence is not promised.
reward: binary; all required checks must pass
target: A realistic scientific analysis task with verifiable outputs, rather than reproducing every implementation detail of the notebook.
specification_scope: Draft scientific question, supplied input derivations, selected output schemas and proposed comparison rules. Validate rules before solving.

approved_scope.inputs: Original expression data plus fixed cell-group assignments derived from the recorded reference. Select the assignment appropriate to its marker analysis and document provenance; do not represent it as biological ground truth.
approved_scope.outputs: Marker/differential-expression results for the supplied groups.
approved_scope.excluded: Discovering clusters and reproducing UMAP coordinates.
approved_scope.constraints: Keep downstream science grounded in the source. Choose and justify remaining preprocessing, test definitions and compact meaningful outputs without prescribing API calls. Do not supply marker answers as inputs.
